div.div: 3 واغدهُ , (L,) inf. n. مُوَاغَدَةٌ, (S, L, K,) He (a man) did like as he (another man) did: (L, K:) accord. to some, specially in pace, or in going, or marching; (L;) he went like him; or kept pace with him: (S *, L:) and he ran with him; or vied with him in running: (K:) you say وَاغَدَتِ النَّاقَةُ الأُخْرَى the she-camel went like, or kept pace with, the other: (L:) and sometimes the term مُوَاغَدَةٌ is used in relation to a single she-camel, because one of her fore legs, and her hind legs, moves with (تُوَاغِدُ) the other. (As, S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
